product_family: GitHub Copilot: AI code assistant with multiple tiers (Free, Pro, Pro+, Max for individuals; Business and Enterprise for organizations) including IDE integrations, CLI, cloud agents, and MCP server support.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2, Type 2 certification available for organizations using GitHub Enterprise Cloud. GitHub maintains SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 1 Type 2 certifications which apply to the GitHub platform and its services.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification available for organizations. The GitHub Data Protection Agreement explicitly lists 'ISO 27001:2013 certifications' as part of security safeguards.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 1, Type 2 certification available for organizations using GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: The GitHub Data Protection Agreement forms part of GitHub Customer Agreement covering legal entity's use of Online Services. GitHub self-certifies compliance with EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, UK Extension, and Swiss-U.S. DPF. 'GitHub will implement and maintain appropriate technical and organizational measures and security safeguards' compliant with GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679), UK GDPR, and Swiss Data Protection Act.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Prohibited data categories in DPA explicitly state: 'Do not provide GitHub with...Protected health information (HIPAA)'. GitHub Copilot is not HIPAA-compliant and must not be used with protected health information or in regulated healthcare environments.

certifications.name: CSA STAR Level 2
certifications.proof_quote: Cloud Security Alliance STAR certification (CSA STAR - Level 2) available for GitHub organizations.

certifications.name: CSA CAIQ Level 1
certifications.proof_quote: Cloud Security Alliance CAIQ self-assessment (CSA CAIQ - Level 1) available for GitHub organizations.

certifications.name: PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: GitHub PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance available through organization compliance settings.

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification for GitHub Copilot. GitHub implements a Responsible AI Standard aligned with NIST AI Risk Management Framework but ISO 42001 certification is not mentioned in trust center or product documentation.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification mentioned in GitHub Copilot or GitHub platform compliance reports.

privacy.ai_training_note: Training treatment depends on the plan tier. Copilot Free, Pro, Pro+, and Max tiers use interactions with GitHub features (inputs, outputs, code snippets) to train and improve AI models as of April 24, 2026, and users can opt out. Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise explicitly do not train on customer data. Users on Free, Pro, and Pro+ can opt out of model training via https://github.com/settings/copilot/features.
privacy.data_region: GitHub stores and processes Personal Data in multiple locations including local region, United States, and other countries. International transfers use EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, Standard Contractual Clauses, UK Addendum, and Swiss SCCs.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Implemented with appropriate security safeguards per SOC 2 Type 2 audit

security.name: Data Retention (Copilot Business/Enterprise)
security.value: Prompts and suggestions retained for 28 days; User Engagement Data retained for 2 years

security.name: Data Retention (Copilot Free/Pro/Pro+/Max)
security.value: Prompts deleted after generation unless retained for model training (with opt-out available)

security.name: Instant Deletion (Enterprise)
security.value: Prompts and suggestions instantly discarded after processing for Copilot Enterprise accounts

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Least privilege principles, audit logs available for Business/Enterprise, admin configuration of restricted paths and repositories

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: GitHub notifies customers of security incidents without undue delay and investigates with reasonable mitigation steps

security.name: Backup & Continuity
security.value: Weekly backup procedures and Services Continuity and Incident Management Plan maintained

security.name: Responsible AI Framework
security.value: Aligned with Microsoft Responsible AI Standard (six principles: accountability, transparency, fairness, reliability/safety, privacy/security, inclusiveness) and NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Responsible AI Impact Assessment completed.

products.name: Copilot Free
products.data_scope: Limited to 2,000 completions per month; data may be used for model training with opt-out available
products.notes: Entry tier for getting started; includes Haiku 4.5, GPT-5 mini; no credit card required

products.name: Copilot Pro
products.data_scope: Unlimited completions; data may be used for model training with opt-out available; $15 monthly AI credits
products.notes: $10/month; includes cloud agents, code review, 3rd-party agents (Claude, Codex), model selection

products.name: Copilot Pro+
products.data_scope: Premium models including Opus; data may be used for model training with opt-out available; $70 monthly credits
products.notes: $39/month; 4x+ included usage vs Pro; premium model access; audit logs

products.name: Copilot Max
products.data_scope: Highest volume tier; data may be used for model training with opt-out available; $200 monthly credits
products.notes: $100/month; priority access to new models; 2.9x+ usage vs Pro+; sustained high-volume workflows

products.name: Copilot Business
products.data_scope: NO model training on user data; DPA coverage; 28-day prompt retention, 2-year engagement data retention
products.notes: For organizations on GitHub Free/Team or GitHub Enterprise Cloud; centralized management; cloud agents; access to model catalog

products.name: Copilot Enterprise
products.data_scope: NO model training on user data; instant discarding of prompts after processing; full DPA + compliance report access
products.notes: GitHub Enterprise Cloud only; priority feature/model access; larger AI credit pools; enterprise audit/governance controls

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (Free/Pro/Pro+/Max for individuals) + B2B organization tiers (Business/Enterprise)
compare.data_residency: Multi-region (local region, US, other countries); international transfers via DPF + SCCs
compare.trains_on_data_note: TIER-DEPENDENT: Free/Pro/Pro+/Max train on user data by default (opt-out available); Business/Enterprise do NOT train on user data

flags: HIPAA NOT supported; explicitly prohibited in DPA. GitHub Copilot must not be used with protected health information.
Model training depends on plan tier: Free, Pro, and Pro+ users default to model training with an opt-out available, while Business and Enterprise customers' data is never trained on.
AI governance certification (ISO 42001) not held. Responsible AI framework implemented (NIST-aligned) but formal ISO 42001 certification not pursued.
Product-specific terms deprecated March 5, 2026. Current subscriptions/renewals governed by GitHub Generative AI Services Terms.
Vendor identity: GitHub, Inc. (Microsoft subsidiary). May be purchased through GitHub directly or Microsoft agreements (different legal terms apply).
Certifications listed (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.) are GitHub platform certifications inherited by Copilot, not Copilot-exclusive certifications.
Prompt retention varies significantly by tier (instant deletion for Enterprise vs. 28 days for Business vs. model training use for Free/Pro).
Data Privacy Framework certification is self-certification (not binding audit); EU GDPR transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses, post-Schrems II.
